title: Shiraishi An — Brand New Style〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Morning, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Morning, An.
Let's do our best again during practice today.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! Now, we just need to wait for Akito and Toya...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm? Is that them?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Kohane, Shiraishi...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Ichika, Hinomori, it's been a minute!
Are you two also headed for practice?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, we're waiting for the others to arrive.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, so are we.
We're waiting for Shinonome and Aoyagi to get here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, since we're here, wanna chat for a little bit while we wait?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, sure.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me... Kohane told me the other day that you joined your school's broadcasting committee, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup! But what made you wanna bring that up?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. So, Ichika's on our school's broadcasting committee.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, really?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Ichika, did you also choose the broadcasting committee because it meant you got to play whatever songs you like over the speakers...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, I think that was one reason.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Another was because I'd have to talk to everyone, which I figured would help me practice talking with the audience and stuff during shows.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, for your shows...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You seem like you're pretty good at that sort of stuff already, Shiraishi. I bet Kamiyama High's lunch broadcasts are gonna start being really fun.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. I dunno how fun they're gonna be until I give it a go, but I have already started looking for songs to play.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Like what? Mind telling us?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I'd also like to know how you're choosing them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. It's not like I've come up with some sort of grand plan or anything.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But everyone wants to enjoy their lunch breaks, right? So, I'm thinking cheerful and upbeat songs are the way to go for then.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And cleaning time feels like a huge drag to some people, so songs with a quick tempo might help them get through it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I guess it's important to consider what your listeners are going to feel.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was thinking about just playing some Miku songs that I like or the ones that we made as a band... Should I rethink that...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, I don't think so!
There's nothing wrong with wanting others to listen to good music.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! I've liked all the Miku songs you've introduced to me so far, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And I want more people to hear your band's songs since they're also really amazing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If anything, Ichika, I think it's good that you have that drive to have more people listen to our songs.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really? Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Drive, huh...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Now that I'm on the broadcasting committee, maybe I should try following my passion

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure you have what it takes to make sure everyone has fun while you try to do what you want, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You think so? Then, I might just go all out.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I bet your broadcasts are going to be so much fun, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're used to putting on shows, so I think we could stand to learn a lot from you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know. I can't really say what I'm gonna talk about, but I can tell you what songs I've chosen.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, are you sure?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! In return, you get to tell me what songs you're gonna choose, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait a second. I could listen to your broadcasts if I had Kohane record them for me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Maybe she could do that whenever Ichika's scheduled to be on air...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I don't know if I'll be able to get clean recordings with everyone else talking...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What if you found an empty classroom? That should make things easier for you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Whoa, wait!
Why do you sound so enthusiastic about this, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha!
